preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(x_i >= 0 and x_i <= 10**9 for x_i in [int(line) for line in stdin.split()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each of the next t lines contains an integer x_i (0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10^9) for which we must construct a test case.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == t and all(line.strip() != '' for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t lines, one for each test case, with no empty lines.

postconditions.expression: all(' ' in line for line in output_lines) or all(line == '-1' for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: For each test case, either output two integers n_i and m_i separated by a space (1 ≤ m_i ≤ n_i ≤ 10^9), or output '-1' if no valid pair exists.

postconditions.expression: all((n_i, m_i) == (-1, -1) or (n_i >= m_i and m_i >= 1 and n_i <= 10**9) for line in output_lines for n_i, m_i in [(int(x) for x in line.split())] if line != '-1')
postconditions.description: If a valid pair (n_i, m_i) is output, it must satisfy 1 ≤ m_i ≤ n_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((n_i == 1 and m_i == 1 and x_i == 1) or (n_i == m_i and x_i == 0) or (n_i >= m_i and x_i == n_i * n_i - (n_i - m_i + 1) * (n_i - m_i + 1)) for line in output_lines for i in range(t) for n_i, m_i in [(int(x) for x in line.split())] if line != '-1' and x_i == int(stdin.split()[i+1]))
postconditions.description: For each x_i, the output pair (n_i, m_i) must satisfy the condition that the maximum number of 1's in an m_i-free n_i × n_i matrix is exactly x_i. The formula for x_i is derived from the maximum 1's in a grid with a checkerboard-like pattern avoiding m_i × m_i all-1 submatrices.

postconditions.expression: all(line == '-1' or (n_i >= m_i and m_i >= 1 and n_i <= 10**9) for line in output_lines for i in range(t) for n_i, m_i in [(int(x) for x in line.split())] if line != '-1')
postconditions.description: If a valid pair (n_i, m_i) is output, it must be feasible (i.e., 1 ≤ m_i ≤ n_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: all(line == '-1' or (n_i == 1 and m_i == 1 and x_i == 1) or (n_i >= m_i and x_i <= n_i * n_i) for line in output_lines for i in range(t) for n_i, m_i in [(int(x) for x in line.split())] if line != '-1' and x_i == int(stdin.split()[i+1]))
postconditions.description: The output pair (n_i, m_i) must yield a valid x_i (i.e., x_i must be achievable as the maximum number of 1's in an m_i-free n_i × n_i matrix).
